modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On October 29, 2008: Delta Air Lines merges with Northwest Airlines, creating the world's largest airline and reducing the number of US legacy carriers to five.
On October 29, 1998: Space Shuttle Discovery blasts off on STS-95 with 77-year-old John Glenn on board, making him the oldest person to go into space at that time.
On October 29, 1985: Major General Samuel K. Doe is announced as the winner of the first multi-party election in Liberia.

image_credit.author: Photographer: Frank Hall, Treatment: Frank C. Müller

did_you_know.fact: On October 29, 1969: The first-ever computer-to-computer link is established on ARPANET, the precursor to the Internet.
October 29 is observed as Coronation Day (Cambodia).
